payout_quote: Use promo code 'KC150' to receive $150 new account bonus for a limited time only. ... Offer valid April 1, 2026 – September 30, 2026 for new FCCU checking account members only. To receive the $150 bonus, you must open a new Kasasa checking account and receive qualifying direct deposits totaling $1,000 or more within 90 days of account opening.
steps: Open a new First Community CU Kasasa checking account online during the offer window (valid through September 30, 2026) using promo code KC150.
Receive qualifying direct deposits (paycheck, pension, or government benefits from an employer/agency; no P2P) totaling $1,000 or more within 90 days of account opening.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the $150 bonus is paid within 120 days of account opening.
catches: EXPIRING 9/30/2026 (7 days from verification) — flagged per the 14-day rule.

Qualifying direct deposits are electronic deposits of paycheck, pension, or government benefits (e.g. Social Security) made by an employer or government agency; transfers between accounts, mobile check deposits, person-to-person payments including Zelle, and branch/ATM deposits do NOT qualify.
Limit one bonus per member household; cannot be combined with other offers; FCCU employees not eligible.
The account must be open and in good standing, with no restrictions, at the time the bonus is paid.
Offer subject to change or cancellation without notice.
